_comment: Sanitized example. Each check must be able to FAIL for a real reason. Validate offline with: WATCHDOG_CONFIG=watchdogs.json python3 scripts/watchdog.py --dry-run

checks.name: example listener unit
checks.why: systemd restarts it on crash; a non-active unit means restarts are exhausted

checks.name: example log fresh
checks.why: a silent log means the process looks healthy but is wedged

checks.name: example scheduler heartbeat
checks.why: no tick means no scheduled job runs; this is the dead-man for the scheduler

checks.name: example local port
checks.why: backend for the local web chat; silent failure means chat is dead

checks.name: example free disk
checks.why: a full disk stops writes everywhere
